title: AI Software Agents
purpose: Software agents that select actions and tools under explicit permissions, evaluation and human oversight; physical robotics and generic tool walkthroughs have separate homes.
case: a versioned agent handling one bounded task
metric: task success, errors and intervention cost
boundary: Use sanitized traces and explicit permission boundaries; demonstrations do not prove autonomous reliability.
evidence: versioned tool schemas, sanitized execution traces, task evaluations and incident records

title: Large Language Model Systems
purpose: Language-model system behavior, retrieval, context, inference and evaluation; research breakthroughs and coding-assistant workflows remain neighboring subjects.
case: a versioned language-model application
boundary: Name model, version, dataset and task; do not treat fluent output as verified knowledge.
evidence: model cards, versioned inference documentation, evaluation sets and reproducible task outputs

title: No-Code & Low-Code Development
purpose: Visual application building, data rules, integrations, deployment and maintenance; general programming and AI-agent behavior are separate scopes.
case: a documented low-code application
boundary: Disclose platform version, licensing and permissions; a working prototype is not a secure production service.
evidence: platform documentation, app schemas, access rules, deployment records and user tests

title: SaaS Businesses
purpose: Subscription software business operations, customer retention, unit economics and service obligations; software implementation and broad startup biography are separate.
case: a named software subscription business
metric: cohort retention, service delivery and costs
boundary: Separate booked revenue, cash, recurring metrics and profit; use dated audited or clearly labelled operational records.
evidence: dated contracts, billing definitions, cohort records, financial filings and service incidents

title: Creator Economy
purpose: Creator business relationships, platform dependence, audience work and rights; content craft and platform tutorials belong to neighboring production niches.
case: a documented creator business arrangement
boundary: Separate gross platform receipts from take-home income; disclose selection bias and actual contract terms.
evidence: creator contracts, platform terms, consented accounts, payment statements and institutional creative-sector data

title: Search Engine Optimization
purpose: Search discoverability, crawling, indexing and measured site outcomes; broad advertising, creator businesses and interface usability are separate.
case: a dated website search change
metric: indexed coverage, qualified visits and user outcomes
boundary: Use dated search documentation and defined metrics; ranking changes do not identify a sole cause or guarantee traffic.
evidence: search-provider documentation, sanitized site logs, controlled change records and measurement definitions

title: Mental Health Education
purpose: Evidence literacy about mental-health conditions, support pathways and social context; general behavior, motivation and individual treatment are separate.
case: a published mental-health education or service evaluation
metric: understanding, access and defined wellbeing outcomes
people: people using services and their communities
boundary: Educational scope only; no diagnosis, personal treatment plan or identifiable private clinical record; require qualified review for publication.
evidence: clinical guidelines, original study methods, validated instruments and consented service-user perspectives

title: Sleep Science
purpose: Human sleep measurement, circadian timing and interpretation of intervention evidence; general lifestyle advice and speculative enhancement are separate.
case: a defined sleep study or measurement method
metric: sleep timing, measured function and uncertainty
boundary: State population, measurement and study design; no individualized sleep or medication prescription.
evidence: sleep-study protocols, instrument validation, circadian experiments and clinical evidence reviews

title: Exercise Science
purpose: Evidence on physical activity, adaptation, measurement and access; sport-specific tactics, bodybuilding instruction and personal medical care are separate.
case: a published exercise or activity intervention
metric: functional change, adherence and adverse outcomes
boundary: Specify population, activity and outcome; do not turn study protocols into personal training or rehabilitation prescriptions.
evidence: activity guidelines, original intervention protocols, measurement validity and reported adverse-event data

title: Ramayana
purpose: Named Ramayana texts, recensions, episodes, translations and living retellings; cross-text mythology, general philosophy and animation production remain separate.
case: one passage or episode in named Ramayana versions
boundary: Cite text, recension, edition and passage; distinguish devotional interpretation, textual evidence and historical inference.
evidence: primary text editions, manuscript catalogues, named translations and attributed community performance records

title: Mahabharata
purpose: Mahabharata textual structure, episodes, recensions, critical editing and reception; the Gita's sustained verse commentary and cross-text mythology have separate homes.
case: one Mahabharata passage in specified editions
boundary: State parvan, passage and edition; no single recension represents all traditions or proves a modern historical claim.
evidence: critical-edition apparatus, primary passages, manuscript catalogues and named commentaries

title: Hindu Festivals & Vrat
purpose: Named Hindu observances, calendars in practice, regional variation and community stewardship; global festival surveys and travel logistics are separate.
case: one named observance in a place and period
boundary: Attribute tradition and location; do not universalize rituals or publish date-sensitive observance guidance without local calendar verification.
evidence: community records, calendar editions, ritual texts, consented accounts and dated institutional archives

title: Bhakti Literature & Devotional Poetry
purpose: Devotional poems, songs, stotras, attribution, translation and performance across named lineages; broad sectarian history and general mantra catalogues are separate.
case: one devotional composition and its documented versions
boundary: Identify language, edition, attribution and performance context; distinguish traditional attribution from independently dated evidence.
evidence: primary compositions, critical editions, attributed recordings, manuscript descriptions and translation notes

title: Ancient Egypt
purpose: Ancient Egyptian societies through material evidence, texts, chronology and daily institutions; broad mystery formats and travel promotion are separate.
case: a provenanced object, site or inscription
boundary: Specify period, provenance and uncertainty; distinguish archaeological interpretation from modern myth or sensational lost-technology claims.
evidence: excavation reports, museum accession records, inscription editions and archaeological chronology

title: Mesopotamian Civilizations
purpose: Distinct Mesopotamian societies through cuneiform, settlements, institutions and exchange; general ancient-history surveys and script tutorials are separate.
case: a catalogued tablet, settlement or archive
boundary: Name polity, period, language and object provenance; avoid treating multiple cultures as one unchanging civilization.
evidence: tablet catalogues, excavation context, transliterations, translations and dated historical scholarship

title: Cricket
purpose: Cricket's formats, rules, tactics, institutions and participant pathways; general sports history and generic fitness remain neighboring niches.
case: a named match, rule edition or competition
boundary: Specify format, competition and season; use official records and avoid unsourced allegations or gambling recommendations.
evidence: official playing conditions, scorecards, match reports, competition rules and attributed participant accounts

title: Football / Soccer
purpose: Association football rules, tactics, competitions and participation; other football codes, generic sports history and conditioning are separate.
case: a documented association-football match or rule change
boundary: Specify association football, competition, season and applicable law edition; distinguish observations from unsupported intent or blame.
evidence: IFAB law editions, official competition records, match data and licensed or independently described footage

title: Graphic Design & Visual Communication
purpose: Typography, layout, image-text communication and design evaluation across print and digital artifacts; interface task research and brand business history are separate.
case: a documented communication-design brief and artifact
boundary: Credit creators and asset rights; separate aesthetic preference from tested communication outcomes.
evidence: original briefs, design files, licensed type specimens, object catalogues and audience studies

title: Video Editing & Post-Production
purpose: Editing, conform, color/audio handoffs, versioning and delivery from recorded media; screenwriting, capture and visual-effects creation have neighboring homes.
case: a consented or original edit project
metric: narrative clarity, technical accuracy and delivery quality
boundary: Name software version and media rights; do not present illustrative edits as original documentary evidence.
evidence: versioned editor manuals, project files, timecodes, export metadata and documented editorial decisions

title: Music Production & Sound Design
purpose: Recording, arrangement, synthesis, sound design, mixing and delivery; music history, AI-music generation and performance criticism are separate.
case: an original or licensed audio production
metric: audible intention, technical measurement and translation
boundary: Separate measured audio properties from taste; record performer, sample and composition rights before use.
evidence: session files, recording documentation, rights records, audio standards and controlled listening comparisons
